verdict.rationale: Kong documents a dedicated streaming capability: requests stream word- or token-level output back to the client in real time, configured through the AI Model entity. The provider-agnostic API suggests this works across providers, but the docs only say 'most models' can stream and never confirm streaming for every provider. missing for 10: explicit per-provider streaming support matrix or statement that streaming works across all providers, protocol/format details (e.g. SSE normalization), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream token-by-token responses through the gateway from any provider

citations.quote: most models can stream each word (or sets of words and tokens) back to the client. This allows the chat response to be rendered in real time.
Request streaming in AI Gateway uses the AI Model entity.
The core of AI Gateway is the ability to serve AI Models from various AI Model Providers via a provider-agnostic API.
